# Google
> Google’s public-facing hub for products, company information, safety, sustainability, AI, and policy resources.

This site serves as Google’s corporate and product gateway, linking to major consumer offerings, company initiatives, developer-adjacent resources, and public policy information.

## Company
- [About Google](https://about.google/): Overview of Google’s mission, products, commitments, and company information.
- [Our Products](https://about.google/products/): Directory of Google consumer and business products.
- [Company News](https://blog.google/): Official Google blog covering announcements, launches, and company updates.
- [Careers](https://careers.google.com/): Jobs, teams, locations, and hiring information across Google.
- [Investor Relations](https://abc.xyz/investor/): Financial reports, governance, and investor information for Alphabet.
- [Contact Google](https://about.google/contact-google/): Public contact options and support entry points.

## Products
- [Search](https://www.google.com/): Google Search homepage.
- [Gmail](https://mail.google.com/): Web access to Gmail email service.
- [Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps): Maps, navigation, and local discovery platform.
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/): Video hosting, streaming, and creator platform.
- [Google Photos](https://photos.google.com/): Photo backup, organization, and sharing service.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/): App, game, book, and media marketplace.
- [Google Chrome](https://www.google.com/chrome/): Browser downloads, features, and platform support.
- [Android](https://www.android.com/): Android platform overview, devices, and ecosystem information.

## AI
- [Google AI](https://ai.google/): Google’s AI research, products, and educational resources.
- [Google DeepMind](https://deepmind.google/): Research organization focused on advanced AI systems and science.
- [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/): Google’s AI assistant and multimodal model experience.
- [Google AI Blog](https://blog.google/technology/ai/): Official posts about AI research, products, and updates.
- [Responsible AI](https://ai.google/responsibility/): Principles, practices, and governance for responsible AI development.
- [Learn About AI](https://ai.google/education/): Educational materials and learning resources about AI concepts and use.

## Safety & Privacy
- [Safety Center](https://safety.google/): Central hub for privacy, security, and online safety information.
- [Privacy Center](https://safety.google/privacy/): Explanations of Google privacy controls, data practices, and settings.
- [Security Center](https://safety.google/security/): Security protections, account safety tools, and best practices.
- [Families](https://families.google/): Family-focused safety tools, parental controls, and digital wellbeing resources.
- [Transparency Center](https://transparency.google/): Policies, moderation practices, and transparency reporting across Google products.
- [Account Help](https://support.google.com/accounts/): Help resources for Google Account access, security, and settings.

## Sustainability
- [Google Sustainability](https://sustainability.google/): Google’s environmental goals, reporting, and sustainability initiatives.
- [Our Commitments](https://sustainability.google/commitments/): Climate, energy, and operational sustainability targets.
- [Reports and Data](https://sustainability.google/reports/): Sustainability reports, metrics, and supporting data.
- [Carbon-Free Energy](https://sustainability.google/operating-sustainably/): Information on operating Google with cleaner energy.
- [Sustainable Products](https://sustainability.google/products/): Product features and tools supporting sustainable choices.

## Policy & Public Affairs
- [Google Public Policy](https://about.google/public-policy/): Policy positions, issue areas, and public affairs work.
- [Government Affairs Blog](https://blog.google/outreach-initiatives/public-policy/): Posts on regulation, policy, and civic initiatives.
- [How Google Works with Governments](https://about.google/public-policy/how-we-work-with-governments/): Overview of engagement with governments and institutions.
- [Competition and Choice](https://about.google/public-policy/competition/): Google’s perspective on competition and consumer choice issues.
- [Content Responsibility](https://about.google/public-policy/content-responsibility/): Information about platform responsibility and content governance.

## Accessibility
- [Google Accessibility](https://about.google/accessibility/): Accessibility commitments, product features, and inclusive design resources.
- [Accessibility Help](https://support.google.com/accessibility/): Support resources for accessibility features across Google products.
- [Android Accessibility](https://support.google.com/accessibility/android/): Accessibility help and setup guidance for Android devices.
- [Chrome Accessibility](https://support.google.com/chrome/topic/7439538): Accessibility-related help for Chrome browser users.

## Support
- [Google Help](https://support.google.com/): Central support portal for Google products and services.
- [Google Account Help](https://support.google.com/accounts/): Help for account management, sign-in, and security issues.
- [Google One Help](https://support.google.com/googleone/): Support for storage, backup, and membership features.
- [Google Play Help](https://support.google.com/googleplay/): Help for purchases, apps, subscriptions, and Play services.
- [YouTube Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/): Support resources for YouTube viewers and creators.
- [Google Maps Help](https://support.google.com/maps/): Help articles for navigation, places, and Maps features.

## News & Stories
- [The Keyword](https://blog.google/): Official Google blog with company and product stories.
- [Product News](https://blog.google/products/): Announcements and updates across Google products.
- [Technology News](https://blog.google/technology/): Posts about engineering, AI, and technical advances.
- [Company News](https://blog.google/company-news/): Corporate announcements, milestones, and initiatives.
- [Safety and Security News](https://blog.google/outreach-initiatives/public-safety/): Updates related to online safety and security efforts.
- [Sustainability Stories](https://blog.google/outreach-initiatives/sustainability/): Articles on climate, energy, and environmental programs.
